svg.title: ASCA100m dated southwestward component spans
svg.desc: 330of931 half-peak section spans resolve;601remain unresolved. All outcomes and three threshold counts are shown, with three prespecified source profiles. Fixed-array component diagnostics, not current widths, geographic boundaries or annual physical ranges.
